evidence.excerpt: pub fn read_blob(&self, oid: &str) -> Result<Vec<u8>, GitError> { Self::validate_oid(oid)?; let output = self.run(&["cat-file", "blob", oid])?; Ok(output.stdout.into_bytes())

subject: src/git/repo.rs::RepoContext::read_blob
text: read_blob returns Vec<u8> but obtains blob content through GitRunner::run, which strictly UTF-8-decodes stdout/stderr and returns GitError::InvalidUtf8 on invalid sequences; therefore reading any non-UTF-8 blob fails with a typed encoding error despite the byte-typed return.
